'''Turn- und Sportverein Hartberg''' (officially known as '''TSV Egger Glas Hartberg''' for sponsorship reasons) is an Austrian professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Hartberg]], [[Styria]]. Founded in 1946, the club plays in the [[Austrian Football Bundesliga|Austrian Bundesliga]], the highest level of the [[Austrian football league system]].

Hartberg were promoted to the Bundesliga for the first time in 2018 and have since established themselves in the top flight. In the [[2019–20 Austrian Football Bundesliga|2019–20 season]], they qualified for European competition for the first time, earning a place in the [[2020–21 UEFA Europa League]] qualifiers.

The club plays its home matches at the [[Stadion Hartberg|Profertil Arena Hartberg]], a 4,500-capacity stadium, and traditionally wears blue and white."}}
